errors.text_span: SQLite (тюркоазена/синьо-зелена линия) е около ~80–100 през 2013, колебае се близо до ~100–140 и към 2020 е около ~120–140
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the color of the SQLite line as 'turquoise/blue-green' when it is red in the legend and chart. Furthermore, it incorrectly describes the trend for SQLite; the trend described (rising to 120-140) actually belongs to Cassandra. The real SQLite line is mostly flat or slightly declining, staying below the 100 score mark.

errors.text_span: Cassandra (светлосиня линия) започва около ~40–60 през 2013, нараства до около ~120–140 към 2015 и след това остава приблизително в диапазона ~110–140 с малки колебания до 2020
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies the color of the Cassandra line as 'light blue' (светлосиня), which is the color used for the Oracle line. The correct color for Cassandra is cyan or turquoise (тюркоазена/синьо-зелена), the same color that was incorrectly attributed to SQLite.
